 South Dakota retailers report optimistic shoppers as holiday season begins 
 Download the KOTA News App. By Tamara Chibe Published : Nov. 15, 2026 at 11:30 AM CST | Updated : 6 hours ago Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google RAPID CITY, S.D. (KOTA) - South Dakota retailers are seeing a positive mood among shoppers as the holiday shopping season gets underway, with nearly 80% describing their customers as upbeat, optimistic or confident, according to a new survey.
 The South Dakota Retailers Association surveyed 460 member businesses in the third quarter. Less than 1% said their customers were pessimistic, while the remaining retailers described shoppers as cautious or careful with their spending.
 “Resoundingly in quarter three, our members said that the mood of their customers was positive,” said Nathan Sanderson, the association’s executive director.
 That optimism is showing up in stores across the state. Brennan Ewald of Forte, a home décor, furniture and gift store in Yankton, said customers are shopping with purpose, particularly for children’s gifts.
 “Making the holiday special for kids seems to be a perennial theme; gifts for kids are going well this season,” Ewald said.
 Retailers also reported interest in gift items such as self-care products, including eye masks and bath bombs, as well as novelty gifts like crocheted-animal kits and color-changing mugs.
 In the Black Hills, holiday decorations are already bringing shoppers into stores. Janet Scherbenske, owner of Found in Rapid City, said customers are decorating earlier and showing interest in items featuring lights and movement.
 Lighted wall plaques, illuminated water lanterns and seasonal fragrances are among the store’s popular items, she said.
 Sanderson said South Dakota retailers are offering a range of holiday merchandise, from locally selected gifts to seasonal home décor.
 The South Dakota Retailers Association represents nearly 4,000 businesses statewide, including retailers, restaurants, grocery stores and hospitality businesses.
